reason: I can't put an unaudited startup with zero customers inline in our trade path, free pilot or not. Our last exam already asked how we use AI, so the vendor who sits in front of agent trades has to pass vendor risk first, and this one can't today.
objection: No SOC 2 and no references, yet it's a proxy every agent trade and payment goes through. If it goes down or gets breached, that's my exam finding, not theirs. Per-action pricing on top of that is hard to budget when I can't forecast agent volume.
would_change_my_mind: A completed SOC 2 Type II report plus two reference customers at regulated US brokers or neobanks, and a flat annual price instead of per-action overage.
